title: Remove the unwanted ‘Also send to channel’ thread-reply option
summary: Owner asked when the ‘Also send to channel’ option was added and requested removal. Product Development Lead said it was added Sep 28 by commit 7427b00, then removed it in ef32838. The commit removes the checkbox and broadcast client state, rejects old-client broadcast=true requests, and adds a regression test asserting normal replies stay out of the channel feed. A subsequent owner reply said the UI still appeared in a stale tab; Product Development Lead refreshed the tab/thread and reported the checkbox absent with the unsent draft preserved. This satisfies the exact ask. Implementation and commit integration on local main are evidenced; test/screenshot passes are reported in-thread, not rerun here. Release/push status is not independently established.
